sources: https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/231874 (facility, notices, rules, rate seasons, RIDB campsite catalog)

values.note: Recreation.gov: 'RV or trailers over 36 feet will have a very tough time making it through the campground because of tight corners and trees.' Its catalog lists 20 sites, RV lengths 15-40 ft (site 20 at 60), 3 pull-throughs; 17 take a 23-ft rig (1, 8 and 18 are 15-20 ft). Most sites have steps down from the road to the table and fire ring.

sites.source: FS page ('Thunder Ridge Campground has 21 campsites with parking areas that are at least 30 feet') + recreation.gov notice ('RV or trailers over 36 feet will have a very tough time making it through the campground because of tight corners and trees. All vehicles including campers must fit in parking spur') + RIDB catalog 231874 (20 sites; lengths; 7, 10, 11 Pull-Through; 19 paved spurs) + facility description ('Most remaining sites have steps that lead below the road level'), read 2026-10-27

facilities.source: FS page ('Facilities include tables, fire grates, drinking water, vault toilets and trash collection'), read 2026-10-27; recreation.gov: hoses may not be attached to the hydrants to fill RVs

values.note: FS: open mid-May to mid-October depending on weather; reduced water/trash service and maybe no host in the shoulder weeks. Recreation.gov's 2027 seasons run May 7 - Oct 10.

season.source: FS page ('Campground is open mid-May to mid-October, depending on weather conditions'; 'Pre-season and extended season have reduced service') + recreation.gov 2027 rate seasons (First-come 2027-05-07 to 05-20, Peak 05-21 to 09-05, First-come 09-06 to 10-10), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reserve at least four days ahead (877-444-6777 or recreation.gov); reservations recommended Memorial Day - Labor Day. The shoulder weeks are first-come only; first-come sites must be occupied the same night, self-service fee tube (cash or check). Two nights on weekends, three on holiday weekends. 14 nights in a rolling 60 days.

booking.source: FS page ('Reservations are recommended between Memorial Day and Labor Day'; 'Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance'; 'First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night') + recreation.gov rules (reservationCutOff 4 days; minWeekendStay 2; minHolidayWeekendStay 3; maxStay 14 in rolling 60 days) + 2027 Peak Season 05-21 to 09-05, read 2026-10-27

values.note: $28 a site (two vehicles or one RV and its tow vehicle); $11 for a third vehicle.

fees.source: FS page ('$28 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one recreational vehicle (RV) per site is included in the camping fee. $11 for a third vehicle') + recreation.gov 2027 rates $28, read 2026-10-27

discounts.source: FS page ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-27

note: Pikes Peak Ranger District (Pike-San Isabel NF) campground above Rampart Reservoir at ~9,200 ft in ponderosa pine, in the Rampart Reservoir Recreation Area off Rampart Range Road (FR 300) north of Woodland Park. Motorized and trailered boats launch Thursday-Sunday 7 a.m.-4 p.m. after an aquatic-nuisance inspection. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: 21 sites (catalog 20), nonelectric, $28, open mid-May - mid-Oct. Added pull-through, facilities (water, vault), season 05-07 to 10-10, booking platform/fcfs after_cutoff/min stay 2/3/max 14/peak 05-21 to 09-05, senior/access discount; fee $28 confirmed. Note rewritten.
flags: Max length: the stored 60 ft was site 20's catalog length; recreation.gov warns that rigs over 36 ft 'will have a very tough time making it through the campground because of tight corners and trees'. Wrote 36. 17 of the 20 catalogued sites take a 23-ft rig.

Access road surface: neither page says. The campground spurs are paved (19 of 20 per the catalog); the route is Baldwin St / Rampart Range Road -> Loy Creek Road -> Rampart Range Road (FR 300) -> recreation-area entrance, 0.7 mi in. No big-rig warning about the approach, only the in-campground one.
Site count: FS says 21, recreation.gov catalog 20 (no site 6).
Pin is 44 m from the centroid of the 20 sites (38.97707,-104.98299). Fine.
Phone: Pikes Peak Ranger District 719-636-1602 (entry has none); FS page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/thunder-ridge-campground.

Closures: the forest's current alerts (Willow Fire area, Aspen Acres) are elsewhere; the campground is closed for the season (FCFS season ended Oct 11, 2026). Did not re-read the Rampart Range Road winter closure order.
